reason_codes.meaning: Every declared operation and final tree, inventory, renderer, and bilingual-alignment gate passed; only provisional canonical output exists.
One exact registry operation produced its declared canonical provisional after state.
The Plan named an operation outside the closed executable registry.
An operation attempted to use a source artifact absent from the complete declared input inventory.
A declared source payload or target unit did not have the exact kind required by the operation.
The operation payload did not account for the complete exact dependency or source-unit closure.
The requested canonical structure or structural transition is outside the deterministic executor contract.
Canonical source-unit ownership, order, or exact-once accounting did not match the declared tree.
The operation selector did not resolve to exactly the declared canonical target set.
The actual target count, locations, structure, or content did not equal the Plan before state.
The provisional locations, structure, content, or ownership did not equal the Plan after state.
The frozen ordinary renderer cannot represent every structural type or source-unit kind in the closed replacement region.
The complete provisional tree failed canonical semantic validation after an operation.
A later declared operation was explicitly not run after an earlier atomic Plan failure.
A complete provisional language tree did not equal the Plan final-tree fingerprint.
A complete provisional source-unit inventory did not equal the Plan inventory fingerprint.
The final English and Traditional Chinese units were not completely and exactly covered by the declared official alignment map.
